learning_objective: 🎯 Let's explore how different materials create unique sounds and learn to design and decorate our own amazing musical instruments!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The sound an instrument makes depends on what it is made of! A wooden box makes a deep, hollow sound, while a metal tin makes a sharp, ringing sound.
The shape and size of an instrument change its music. A big drum makes a low, booming beat, while a tiny flute makes a high, sweet chirp like a bird.
Traditional instrument makers are also great artists! They carve beautiful designs into wood and paint bright patterns to make the instrument look as good as it sounds.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Make a Rubber Band Guitar!
fun_activity.instructions: Stretch three different sized rubber bands around an empty tissue box. Pluck them one by one to hear the different notes, then paint the box like a real rockstar guitar!

quick_recap: ⭐ Different materials like wood, metal, and plastic create completely different sounds.
⭐ The size and shape of an instrument help decide how high or low its music will be.
⭐ Decorating instruments with colorful art makes playing them even more fun.
